products.title: Masters 2025 - Small Batch
products.body_html:
Probably the closest we're all getting to playing Augusta. 

Using the classic Masters and Augusta colour palette we have created a small batch release limited to 15 pairs. In your bag they will give you consistent inspiration that if you work on your alignment you might just hit a few good shots, win the medal, win the club champs, win the county champs, win the national champs and get an invite to Augusta.

No promises that the above will happen but good alignment will definitely help.

In additional to all of the above you can also have your initials added to this Small Batch order.
